note: Historic replay set (#339). Each episode freezes a feed at as_of from the M1 stores (no fact dated after as_of) and pairs it with an answer key read after the event. Trigger dates were checked 2026-11-20 against the cited public source: Agência Brasil for agency actions and the BTG arrest, the BCB resolution-regime register (api/servico/sitebcb/Regesp_Internet/Detalhamento) for failures.

excluded.reason: Banco Santos (intervention 2004-11): the BCB register lists it without detail (exibirDetalhamento false), so the date is not checkable there; no REF before 2008-11, no board minutes before 2014, no rate data before 2012. The pack would hold one IF.data quarter.
